sections.body: A paragraph is a group of sentences about ONE main idea.
Start with a TOPIC SENTENCE that says the main idea. Add 2–4 SUPPORTING sentences with details or examples. End with a CONCLUDING sentence.
Good writers PLAN (list ideas), DRAFT (write it), then EDIT (fix spelling, punctuation and unclear bits).
Write a paragraph about your favourite animal: one topic sentence, three facts, one ending sentence.

quiz.q: Which is the best topic sentence for a paragraph about why dogs make good pets?
options: Dogs make loyal and friendly pets.
hints: A topic sentence states the MAIN idea.
Which sentence covers the whole paragraph, not just one detail?
For a paragraph about healthy breakfasts, 'A healthy breakfast gives you energy' is the topic sentence. 'I had toast' is a detail.
quiz.explain: 'Dogs make loyal and friendly pets' states the main idea. The others are details.

quiz.q: What's the right order for writing?
hints: What do you do before you start writing?
You fix mistakes after you've written something.
Building a model: first look at the plan, then build, then fix wobbly parts.
quiz.explain: Plan first, then draft, then edit.
